name: GLM 4.5 Flash
short: Z.ai's high-speed, free-tier lightweight language model with 128K context, dual thinking modes, and optimized agentic tool execution.
pricingNote: Free on Zen; $0.00/$0.00 on Z.ai developer platform
standout: Zero-cost developer tier featuring interleaved thinking modes, up to 98K max output generation, and robust tool-calling support.
tradeoff: Inherits lightweight distilled parameter footprint relative to flagship GLM-4.5 (355B MoE), resulting in lower headroom on multi-file SWE-bench tasks.
